name: xxd-panel-211
title_zh: 211号面板：语义配色几何小景生成器
tagline_zh: 不是滤镜，是先定语义再落色：每个色块都对应一个含义，几何小景因此有叙事。想要一张能直接进画册的 211 面板。
tagline_en: Not a filter: assign meaning first, then colour. Every shape carries a role, so the vignette reads as a story.
desc_en: Create Panel 211 raster artwork: Semantic-colour Geometric Vignette. Use when the user invokes xxd-panel-211 or requests this specific visual language.
why_zh: 先建语义—色彩映射，再排几何构图，色不是挑好看的，是被含义推出来的。
why_en: It builds a semantic-to-colour map first, then lays out geometry; hues are derived from meaning, not taste.
limit_zh: 只出 211 面板这一种栅格风格，不做写实、不做照片改绘；语义映射要你先给含义清单，没给就停在提问；产物是位图。
limit_en: Only Panel 211 raster style — no realism, no photo repaint. Needs your meaning list first, otherwise it stops and asks. Output is bitmap, no vector.
